notes:
The leaf, numbered44 by the author and foliated88 in a finer separate hand, continues a discussion of the last row of (26), gives (27) for the fibre U_s/k(s), then summarises the henselised relative-curve situation. The inserted underlined pas is explicit in the phrase pas stricte. One reference digit is overwritten; it is not a repeated whole (25) after (26). The rational-section paragraph has three raised formulas with oblique leaders, including a tilde-f insertion that C did not mark as such. The shorthand before un relèvement is a plain equals sign. The square diagram keeps its unheaded top connector and its uncertain lower-left label. Diagram (28) keeps lambda over the horizontal arrow and the upward isomorphism from the lower E_U_s to the right-hand target. Its lower E is heavily retraced; no independently legible cancelled letter is asserted. The following parenthetical relation has a left arrow with an isomorphism mark. Tiny end strokes of (27), the crowded inserted f subscript, and the final open underlined O/U remain explicit local doubts. The final phrase remains incomplete at sont, with no completion from another leaf. The line count counts22 principal source text/display/diagram baselines, excluding the author page number, folio, and raised insertion baselines. E/cal-E and O/cal-O wrapper differences alone have not been counted as readings. Mathematical context suggested where to inspect but did not supply any letter or arrow. No mathematical assertion was proved or independently used; check_events is empty. Whole image and supplied halves were each read once; each of19 saved crops was inspected once, and no decided place was recropped. Final independent root review covered all19 existing crops. After blind adjudication, the internal pi-to-E link in (27) prefers a shaft, with an arrow alternative; its rounded endpoint does not establish an independent barb. The first diagram left vertical connector has no secure barb; a plain vertical shaft is the first reading, with downward arrow alternative. It is represented by an explicit middle-row symbol to put the doubt on the connector rather than on either object. These two additions change certainty only and do not create lexical-change rows. The visible underline on the final O/U is preserved, but H’s calligraphic O is the same typographic convention as elsewhere; that wrapper difference alone is excluded from the substantive collation. The open letter remains unresolved in the marks and doubts tables.

Blind crop adjudication revises the overwritten reference to underlying 6|5 and live 5|6, both explicitly doubtful; the darker top bar favors a 5 even though the nearby diagram sequence would suggest 26. The small K-like subscript beside the inserted f has cancellation strokes distinct from its leader and is now recorded as cancelled. The pi-to-E connector in (27) has only a rounded endpoint and now prefers a shaft; the clear next arrow remains headed. The article les/le, accent in définit, flattened peut/par and infinitive ending remain local doubts. Diagram (28) retains its upward arrow: a chevron is visible at the upper endpoint beside a wavy label. The lower E is retraced but no distinct underlying letter is readable. All fourteen differing boxes were inspected; 44 remains author pagination and 88 separate foliation.
